verdict.rationale: Zulip's docs describe a topic model in which many conversations run in the same channel at once, each in its own topic, and you can start a new topic from anywhere. Independent community users repeatedly name threading as Zulip's key feature, including creating threads on the fly from existing messages. One user reports occasionally posting to a different thread than expected, a UX caveat rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: first-party docs on replying from a specific message so the reply stays attached to it (the documented model is named topics, not per-message reply chains), and docs on any admin-specific thread controls.
